impact.text: exposing the pool for continual attack which the ‘onlyGuardian’ tried to prevent by setting the lockMode as ‘3’

precondition_sources.text: The guardian has set the pool's lockMode to '3' to prevent continual attack.

intent_sources.text: rebaseOraclePack must not clear or alter the lockMode; the lockMode set by the guardian must be preserved across rebaseOraclePack execution.
Only the guardian may unlock the pool via unlockPool; rebaseOraclePack must not perform the guardian-only unlock.
